title: Red car with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- car body -->
  <rect x='12' y='52' width='76' height='24' rx='10' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- lighter shade top edge of body -->
  <rect x='14' y='54' width='72' height='6' rx='4' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- cabin roof -->
  <path d='M32 52 L40 34 Q41 31 45 31 L64 31 Q68 31 70 34 L78 52 Z' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- windshield -->
  <path d='M40 50 L46 36 Q47 34 49 34 L63 34 Q66 34 67 36 L72 50 Z' fill='#8ecae6'/>
  <!-- windshield shine -->
  <path d='M45 48 L49 37 L53 37 L49 48 Z' fill='#d5f0fb'/>
  <!-- windows side -->
  <rect x='56' y='40' width='14' height='9' rx='2' fill='#8ecae6'/>
  <!-- face eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='64' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='64' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='63' r='1.5' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='63' r='1.5' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M34 71 Q44 79 54 71' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='9' fill='#3d405b'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='4' fill='#8ecae6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='9' fill='#3d405b'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='4' fill='#8ecae6'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='60' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
